name: SAR Filing by MLRO — Service Boundaries
description: Service boundary definitions for JRN-003. This is primarily a single-capability journey (CAP-005 Compliance & Regulatory). Cross-capability interaction occurs only via the SARFiled event consumed by SVC-001 (CAP-001 Retail Banking) for account restriction coordination. No customer-facing services (SVC-017 Digital Channels) are involved or notified.

services.name: KYC/AML Service
services.role_in_journey: PRIMARY OWNER — orchestrates the entire SAR filing workflow. Owns all SAR entities and events. Enforces tipping-off prohibition at service level.

owned_entities_added_by_jrn003.name: SuspiciousActivityReport
owned_entities_added_by_jrn003.description: The formal SAR record. Created on MLRO filing decision. Contains NCA submission data, consent regime status, and SLA compliance tracking.

owned_entities_added_by_jrn003.name: SARInvestigationRecord
owned_entities_added_by_jrn003.description: MLRO internal investigation record. Created on suspicion trigger. Exists for all investigations regardless of outcome.

boundary_rules: SVC-014 is the exclusive owner of ENT-008 and ENT-009 — no other service reads or writes these entities directly
All SAR workflow state transitions are enforced within SVC-014 — external services influence state only via events
The NCA SAR Online integration is owned by SVC-014 — no other service submits to the NCA
Tipping-off enforcement: SVC-014 must not include SAR narrative, NCA reference, or investigation details in events published to services that could surface them to customers
SARFiled event (EVT-016) payload is minimal — contains only customer_id and restriction_required flag. SVC-001 must not receive the NCA reference, grounds of suspicion, or any SAR narrative

access_denied_to: SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core — read only receives restricted SARFiled payload)

services.name: Compliance Core
services.role_in_journey: MLRO WORKFLOW SUPPORT — provides the case management UI layer used by PER-052 to work through the SAR investigation and preparation steps. SVC-015 does not own SAR entities but orchestrates the MLRO user experience and enforces UI-level tipping-off controls.
responsibilities: MLRO case management dashboard — lists open investigations, SLA status, and pending actions
SAR form assembly UI — renders the NCA SAR form fields drawing from SVC-014 data
SLA warning display — surfaces 4-day and 5-day SLA warnings to MLRO
Tipping-off review confirmation — UI checkbox that MLRO must tick before submission is enabled
Audit trail viewer — MLRO can view their own investigation timeline (read-only, sourced from SVC-014)
Annual MLRO report data aggregation — aggregates SAR metrics for annual board report

integration_with_svc014.call_pattern: Synchronous API calls to SVC-014 for all entity reads and writes. SVC-015 does not hold SAR entity state independently.
integration_with_svc014.purpose: SVC-015 is a UI/orchestration service that delegates all data persistence to SVC-014. This ensures there is a single system of record for SAR data under MLRO governance.

access_controls.ui_access: Role-gated to PER-052 and PER-053 only. Step-up MFA required. Separate application from standard compliance desktop.
access_controls.api_access: SVC-015 calls SVC-014 APIs with a service-level identity (not individual MLRO credential). Individual MLRO identity is propagated via request headers for audit attribution.

services.name: Retail Banking Core
services.role_in_journey: CONSUMER — receives SARFiled event (EVT-016) to apply account restrictions and enhanced monitoring flags where the MLRO has determined restrictions are required. SVC-001 has no knowledge of SAR details — it acts only on the restriction_required flag.

consumed_events_added_by_jrn003.name: SARFiled
consumed_events_added_by_jrn003.purpose: SVC-001 reads the restriction_required flag in the SARFiled event. If restriction_required = true, SVC-001 applies an enhanced monitoring flag to all accounts belonging to the customer. SVC-001 does NOT receive or store the NCA reference, SAR narrative, or any SAR detail — only the customer_id and restriction_required boolean.
consumed_events_added_by_jrn003.tipping_off_note: SVC-001 must not surface any account restriction to the customer in a way that reveals the SAR reason. Account restriction notices must use generic approved language only.

published_events_added_by_jrn003: EVT-019 (AccountRestrictionApplied — published when SVC-001 applies restriction on receipt of SARFiled)
boundary_rules: SVC-001 receives only the minimal SARFiled payload — customer_id and restriction_required flag
SVC-001 must not store the SAR relationship beyond an internal enhanced_monitoring_flag on the Account entity
SVC-001 must not expose the SAR link to any customer-facing API or UI
Account restriction messaging to customers must use pre-approved generic language (reviewed by MLRO and Legal)

services.name: Audit & Logging
services.role_in_journey: PASSIVE AUDITOR — receives all SAR events and MLRO action logs for immutable audit logging. No active role in SAR workflow.
services.human_access: auditor_only — dual-person integrity required for any read access to SAR audit logs

cross_capability_event_flows.payload_restriction: Minimal payload only: { sar_id: UUID (internal reference), customer_id: UUID, restriction_required: boolean, filed_at: timestamp }. No SAR narrative, no NCA reference, no typology codes, no investigation detail.
cross_capability_event_flows.tipping_off_protection: Payload is designed so that even if SVC-001 were compromised or its logs accessed by an unauthorised party, no SAR-identifying information would be disclosed to a subject.

cross_capability_event_flows.purpose: Audit log of account restriction application. Feeds into MLRO annual report data.

services_explicitly_excluded.name: Digital Channels
services_explicitly_excluded.reason: No customer-facing interaction in this journey. SVC-017 must not receive any SAR-related event. Explicit deny rule at API gateway and event bus subscription level.

services_explicitly_excluded.name: Notification Service
services_explicitly_excluded.reason: No notifications are sent to any customer at any stage. SVC-053 must not be called by SVC-014 or SVC-015 in the context of this journey.
